data.name: Din
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Dīn’ which means religion, belief, or faith. In Islamic context, it refers to the belief and practice of Islam as a way of life. The term is also used for various Islamic legal systems and jurisprudence.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of one's commitment to Allah and living a righteous life.
data.numerology_meaning: People with the name Din are nurturers and caretakers. They are responsible, loving, and practical. They have a strong desire to help others and often put others before themselves.

in_arabic.name: دين
in_arabic.meaning: الدين اسم الله الحسنى و معناه الدين الحق
in_arabic.long_meaning: الدين هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى في الإسلام، ويعني الدين الحق الذي جاء به النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم. ورد ذكر اسم الله الدين في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران آية ١٩ وَدِينُ الْحَقِّ أُحِزَ اِنَّهُ لَا يَشُكُّ فِيهِ وَاللَّهُ بِالنَّاسِ لَخَبِيرٌ

in_urdu.name: دین
in_urdu.meaning: دین حق کا مطلب ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کے ذریعہ بھیجا گیا
in_urdu.long_meaning: دین حق کا مطلب ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کے ذریعہ بھیجا گیا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اللہ تعالیٰ کے ٩٩ ناموں میں سے ایک ہے۔ یہ نام قرآن کریم میں سورة آل عمران میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: दीन
in_hindi.meaning: दीन का अर्थ है सच्चा धर्म जो अल्लाह द्वारा भेजा गया
in_hindi.long_meaning: दीन का अर्थ है सच्चा धर्म जो अल्लाह द्वारा भेजा गया है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में अल्लाह के ९९ नामों में से एक है। यह नाम कुरआन में सूरत आल इमरान में उल्लेखित है।

in_pashto.name: دين
in_pashto.meaning: دين معنی دى هغه حق دين چې الله تعالى رالېږى
in_pashto.long_meaning: دين معنی دى هغه حق دين چې الله تعالى رالېږى دى. دا نوم د اسلامي دود په الله تعالى د ٩٩ نومونو کې يو دى. دا نوم د قرآن کريم په سورت آل عمران کې ياد شوى دى.

in_english.name: Din
in_english.meaning: Din means the right religion or faith sent by Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Din is one of the 99 names of Allah in Islam, signifying the true religion or faith sent by Allah through prophets. It is mentioned in the Quran, Surah Al-Imran, verse 19, emphasizing the importance of surrendering to the will of Allah. The name Din symbolizes spiritual guidance and adherence to Islamic principles.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Taymiyah (1263-1328 CE) was a major figure in Islamic history, known for his role in the revival of the Hanbali school of Islamic jurisprudence.
historical_references.context: Ibn Taymiyah used the term 'Din' to refer to the complete way of life that Muslims should follow according to Islamic law.

historical_references.reference: The Ottoman Empire (1299-1922 CE) was a major Islamic state, and the term 'Din-i Osmani' referred to the state religion and legal code followed by its citizens.
historical_references.context: The Ottoman sultans were considered the protectors of the Islamic faith and the custodians of the Islamic law, and the term 'Din-i Osmani' reflected this role.
